phase_program.granularity: row fence per128-row region; group readiness joins64 row acknowledgements; down chunks depend on local and child data

initial_bindings.before: each maximum or encoded-payload gather phase

credits.release: outgoing send callback; reset first queue color on every phase
local+child add, outgoing send callback, then next receive
actual successor consumption and all outgoing callbacks

warnings: A send callback alone is not a region readiness fence.
An acyclic completion DAG alone does not prove queue binding, forwarding drain or deadlock freedom.
Epoch reset requires a fabric-wide termination protocol that has not been lowered.

decisions.consumes: actual predecessor BF16 output; retain original for residual
decisions.produces: one65-word original group128 packet, forked to both projections
preserves: group128 max clamp1e-10, divide by448, nearest-even E4M3FN
decisions.trigger: global RMS ready for this token
decisions.barrier: original5120-value RMS; per-group maximum; not an extra model-wide barrier

decisions.kind: packed direct edge plus same-actor epilogue
decisions.source_epilogue: each projection root rounds two FP32 sums to BF16 and packs one u32
decisions.edge_payload: one u32 gate plus one u32 up per pair, adjacent opposing neighbors
decisions.consumer_epilogue: expand gate; SiLU; BF16 round; multiply BF16 up; BF16 round; local absmax
decisions.trigger: both actual root packets arrived for this pair
decisions.barrier: two local operands only; no17408-output vector barrier

decisions.kind: cooperative128-value fusion and direct native packet
decisions.consumer_epilogue: 64 pairs contribute local max; scale broadcast; each pair encodes one packed FP16/256 word
decisions.edge_payload: 64 encoded u32 words plus original FP32 scale; consumed directly by native down kernel
decisions.trigger: this128-value group and its route-readiness acknowledgements complete
decisions.barrier: one original128-value quantization group, not all136 groups
decisions.release: consumer native completion and outgoing send callback before packet/scratch reuse

decisions.kind: credited chunk stream plus same-owner epilogue
decisions.consumer_epilogue: round final FP32 down sum to BF16; add retained BF16 residual; BF16 round
decisions.edge_payload: bounded FP32 chunks until complete K136 reduction, then BF16 successor chunks
decisions.trigger: all original K contributions for this output chunk
decisions.barrier: full K136 per chunk; next RMS needs global5120 sum, but local squares may start on arrival

fusion.fp8_scale_implementation: Preserve existing CSL FP32(maximum * FP32(1/448)); literal FP32(maximum /448) is a separately reported oracle and can differ by1ULP. This fusion does not silently change that convention or certify original full-model numerical alignment.
metrics_required: tensor payload and control traffic per directed link
live bytes and code/stack per role

memory.weight_assignment: Original tile coordinate ownership exists; resident slot assignment and complete27B packing do not.
memory.scale_copy_representation: Original BF16 scale_inv expanded exactly to FP32, one per native tile;64 copies per original matrix scale. This increases resident bytes beyond original tensor bytes.

prior_atlas_comparison.required: Cohost original banks on sufficient helper roles or recompute complete model packing; do not subtract original weights to fit this layer.

gate-bank-worker.unspecified: code, flags, route words, row acknowledgements, SDK, alignment

aliases.overwrite_after: previous phase final consumer AND outgoing callback

cost.scope: Known family word-hop counts only;128 is not an admitted total-link maximum and40x smaller streams is not a40x speedup.

scope: Complete original5120/17408 ownership, real operator interfaces and selected spatial stream families. This is a candidate lowering, not an executable subgraph, admitted27B placement or performance result.

audit.scope: Every original FP8 matrix tile, replicated scale index and active actor coordinate; input multicast, every gate/up contraction and adjacent packed activation operand, and inter-region down streams. Missing families, leases, slot packing, numerical order and compiled SRAM are not admitted.
